# Storage & Engine Requirements Quality Checklist: Foundation & Game Engine

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ rõ ràng, tính nhất quán và độ phủ yêu cầu cho động cơ JSON Database cục bộ, bộ nạp Catalog và khung vòng lặp mô phỏng (`001-foundation-game-engine`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all persistent entity collections and their sharding boundaries explicitly specified without relying on any external DBMS or third-party service? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact steps of single-file atomic write and multi-file JSON WAL recovery specified for both partial-write and post-commit crash states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are local rotating backup schedules, retention counts, and pre-migration snapshot rules completely defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all 12 static catalog files and their cross-reference failure behaviors explicitly specified in the boot validation requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Are graceful shutdown requirements defined for draining in-flight locks and flushing dirty runtime states without data loss? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK006 Is the `idempotencyKey` retention window (`>= 24 hours`) and duplicate-response behavior unambiguously quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the lock acquisition timeout (`3000 ms`) and caller-facing fallback error semantics explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the simulation loop target frequency (`20 Hz`), dirty checkpoint interval (`30s`), and logical pixel viewport (`640x360`) quantified with verifiable values? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Are unverified performance targets clearly distinguished from proven benchmarks as `proposed / unverified`? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §VIII]

## Requirement Consistency & Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK010 Do all storage, caching, and static-asset requirements consistently forbid PostgreSQL, TypeORM, Redis, S3, and third-party SaaS across `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `data-model.md`? [Consistency, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the decoupling rules between server simulation ticks, disk JSON writes, Phaser rendering, and React UI state mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Constitution §IV]

## Edge Cases, Security & Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements specified for handling manually tampered or checksum-mismatched JSON files without destructive silent overwrites? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are path-traversal prevention rules explicitly required before resolving any entity identifier into a filesystem path? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are disk-full or write-permission failure behaviors specified to protect existing player JSON files via safe read-only degradation? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are index-desynchronization recovery requirements specified so corrupted secondary JSON indexes can be rebuilt from primary aggregate files? [Recovery, Spec §FR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK016 Are single-node NVMe/SSD operational assumptions and scaling boundaries transparently documented without unverified MMO-scale claims? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
